examDefinition: Operational Expenditure (OpEx) is a cloud consumption model where customers pay for services and computing as they are used without upfront infrastructure investments.
useCases: Budget agility allowing cost adjustments monthly
Tax advantages deducting cloud costs in the year incurred
bestPractices: Leverage Azure Cost Management to track spending against forecasts
Rightsize resources continuously using Azure Advisor
Tag resources by department and cost center for chargebacks
